items.quote: The Bot API is an HTTP-based interface created for developers keen on building bots for Telegram.
items.why: Quote covers HTTP Bot API only; says nothing on MTProto user API or messaging scope.

items.quote: To get started, message @BotFather on Telegram to register your bot and receive its authentication token.
items.why: Quote shows BotFather issues bot token; no mention of URL embedding, user-account API, or other auth methods.

items.quote: You will get basic addresses as well as the api_id and api_hash parameters required for user authorization.
items.why: Quote names api_id/api_hash for user authorization; no my.telegram.org source, session string, or OAuth detail.

items.quote: The Telegram Bot Platform hosts more than 10 million bots and is free for both users and developers.
items.why: Quote says platform is free for users and developers; no self-serve credential signup or Stars detail.

items.quote: You are welcome to use both APIs free of charge.
items.why: Quote says both APIs free of charge; does not state self-serve credential gate.

items.quote: All queries to the Telegram Bot API must be served over HTTPS and need to be presented in this form:
items.why: Quote supports HTTPS requirement only; no 100+ methods, SDK, or bot-visibility limits.

items.quote: We support GET and POST HTTP methods.
items.why: Quote supports GET/POST methods only; rest of claim (breadth, SDK, restrictions) unsupported.

items.quote: It exposes Telegram account, chat, message, contact, media, folder, and admin operations through the Model Context Protocol
items.why: Quote describes an MCP server exposing Telegram operations; does not name the chigwell repo or vendor status.

items.quote: By default, bots are able to message their users at no cost
items.why: Quote is about free bot messaging cost; says nothing about verdict build_now or blockers.
